mechanisms.evidence_quote: Therefore, the model cannot be considered very accurate for small productions (< 200 MNm3) despite all the sites analyzed are included inside the upper and lower curves.
However, the lower curve presents negative asymptotic behavior, in the very beginning.
This result is aligned with literature data (for liquid higher energy consumption [17]) and it is mainly due to the energy consumption of recompression steps after distillation process.
The production of gas is very variable in terms of total production (from 10⋅106 to 1000⋅106 Nm3/year) and composition of products (that is heterogeneous reported on the energy audits).

First, the statistics of 2018 present a higher standard deviation on the Real EnPI (52% vs. 38%), but regression model presents a higher correlation (R2=0.873 vs. 0.736) compared to 2022 data. Hence, it is necessary to improve the comparability of data.
mechanisms.effect_other_verbatim: temporal comparability of the model between audit cycles is limited

adaptations.evidence_quote: Hence, additional analysis by production intervals should be carried out.
Further analysis will be focused on the analysis of different variables that affect energy efficiency of the industrial gases sector.

Finally, a detailed analysis of the distribution of share of final products (oxygen, nitrogen and argon) and its state (gas or liquid) is required to better understand the energy performance of the technical gas sector

reviewer_notes: Paper is a multi-site sector benchmarking study of Italian industrial gas (air separation) production based on mandatory energy audits. Two model constructs are reported (Real EnPI = mean SEC; EnPI Model = linear regression of energy consumption vs production), each computed for primary and electrical energy, so four models are recorded. The regression dependent variable is absolute energy consumption (Energy Consumption [toe] = a·Production + b); the EnPI model is a derived SEC transformation. R2 values are taken from Table 1 (page 11); page reference may need review because table text is fragmented. Re-estimation is coded periodic (every four-year audit cycle) as the EnPIs were recomputed for 2018 and 2022. Refinery/petrochemical flag set to 'named but not an empirical application' because refineries appear only as siting context and as an external benchmark.
